ns2:section.sectionText: Seats are reserved for LAS Access and Achievement Program (LAS EOP and PAP) students, specifically for LAS, EOP and PAP students who are sophomores, juniors and seniors. If you do not meet this requirement, please contact the Access and Achievement Program Office in 112 English Bldg. to be placed on the waiting list.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Liberal Arts & Sciences. Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to EOP - Obligatory, Pres Award Program Recip, or AAP - Undeclared students.
